basic_details.job_title: DHFWS Purulia Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Staff Nurse, Pharmacist Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health, Purulia (Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal) is filling 3 contractual posts under the National Health Mission for the District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, Purulia: 2 Staff Nurse (NUHM) posts at a consolidated Rs.25,000/- a month and 1 Pharmacist (NUHM) post at Rs.22,000/- a month. Only permanent residents of West Bengal may apply, online only through www.wbhealth.gov.in, from 19 November 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 3 December 2026; the last date of online registration is 2 December 2026.

age_limit.details: Age relaxation for reserved categories is admissible as per the prevailing rules/orders of the Government of West Bengal, and only for candidates belonging to the categories for which such relaxation is permissible under those rules. The notice does not list the years of relaxation category by category. The prescribed conditions are non-relaxable. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Go to www.wbhealth.gov.in and open Quick links → Career, Education & Recruitment → Online Recruitment.
Complete the online registration by 2 December 2026; the online application window runs from 19 November 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 3 December 2026.
Submit only one online application for a particular post. A candidate may apply for more than one post if he/she meets the eligibility of each post.
Check every entry before final submission: no modification or correction is allowed after the application is finally submitted.
Do not send any physical documents to the office.
When called for document verification, attend in person with the signed online-generated application form, all original documents and one set of self-attested copies.
Online-generated application form, duly signed by the candidate, with one recent passport-size photograph pasted on it
Madhyamik (or equivalent) Admit Card/Certificate as proof of age
All relevant mark sheets and pass certificates
Valid EWS certificate issued by the competent authority, wherever applicable
Caste certificate issued by the competent authority of the Government of West Bengal, wherever applicable
Voter ID/Aadhaar Card/any other valid address proof
All relevant experience certificates, along with salary slips for the last three months against each claimed period of experience
Conversion formula, where DGPA/CGPA or Grade Point is awarded

Applicants may also be asked to submit other documents desired by the District Level Selection Committee (DLSC), for which prior notice will be given. Failure to produce any requisite document may result in cancellation of candidature.
important_instructions: Any omission or suppression of information will result in rejection of the application or cancellation of candidature at any stage without further intimation. More than one application for the same post by the same candidate will result in cancellation of all applications submitted for that post. The experience certificate must clearly show the duration of experience, post held, nature of work and the employer's signature with date; otherwise it will be treated as invalid. Incomplete online applications are liable to result in cancellation of candidature. False, misleading or forged information or documents found at any stage, or during engagement, will lead to cancellation of candidature/engagement, without prejudice to other action under applicable rules/law. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing in the Computer Test, Written Test, Interview, Document Verification or any other stage. The District Health & Family Welfare Samiti reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason. For updates, the notice asks candidates to visit the official website of the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal, and the concerned district website. Office e-mail printed on the notice: [email protected].

Purulia district – any health facility/institution/unit under the District AYUSH Samity/District Health & Family Welfare Samiti

content_sections.heading: About CMOH Purulia
content_sections.text: The Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health, Purulia, works under the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal, from the Zilla Swasthya Bhawan Campus, Ranchi Road, Purulia. These posts are for the District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, Purulia, under the National Health Mission, and the notice is signed by Dr. Asok Biswas, CMOH & Secretary of the Samiti.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice offers 3 posts in all, with the category of each vacancy printed against the post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: All applicants must be permanent residents of West Bengal and must possess adequate knowledge of the local language. Each post has its own essential and desirable conditions, given below. The candidate should have completed the GNM course by Indian Nursing Council, OR completed the B.Sc. Nursing Course. The candidate must be registered under WBNC. The candidate should have proficiency in the local language. Desirable: experience in working at Hospital setting. Age: maximum age limit 40 years as on 01.04.2026. The applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal. Two years Diploma in Pharmacy (D-Pharma) (Allopathic) recognized by the Government of West Bengal, and registered as "A" category Pharmacist under West Bengal Pharmacy Council. Weightage will be given for higher qualification. The candidate must have efficiency in computers including MS Office and internet. Desirable: weightage will be given for higher qualification (B-Pharma/M-Pharma). Age: minimum 18 years, maximum age limit 40 years as on 01.04.2026. Age relaxation for reserved categories is admissible as per the prevailing rules/orders of the Government of West Bengal, and only for candidates belonging to the categories for which such relaxation is permissible under those rules. The notice does not list the years of relaxation category by category. The prescribed conditions are non-relaxable. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Staff Nurse (NUHM) receives a consolidated remuneration of Rs.25,000/- per month and the Pharmacist (NUHM) Rs.22,000/- per month. The engagement is purely contractual and temporary in nature; the notice does not state the length of the contract. Selected candidates may be posted at any health facility, institution or unit under the administrative control of the District AYUSH Samity/District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, as decided by the competent authority, and no claim for posting at a particular place will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMOH Purulia Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to www.wbhealth.gov.in and open Quick links → Career, Education & Recruitment → Online Recruitment. Complete the online registration by 2 December 2026; the online application window runs from 19 November 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 3 December 2026. Submit only one online application for a particular post. A candidate may apply for more than one post if he/she meets the eligibility of each post. Check every entry before final submission: no modification or correction is allowed after the application is finally submitted. Do not send any physical documents to the office. When called for document verification, attend in person with the signed online-generated application form, all original documents and one set of self-attested copies. Online-generated application form, duly signed by the candidate, with one recent passport-size photograph pasted on it Madhyamik (or equivalent) Admit Card/Certificate as proof of age All relevant mark sheets and pass certificates Valid EWS certificate issued by the competent authority, wherever applicable Caste certificate issued by the competent authority of the Government of West Bengal, wherever applicable Voter ID/Aadhaar Card/any other valid address proof All relevant experience certificates, along with salary slips for the last three months against each claimed period of experience Conversion formula, where DGPA/CGPA or Grade Point is awarded Applicants may also be asked to submit other documents desired by the District Level Selection Committee (DLSC), for which prior notice will be given. Failure to produce any requisite document may result in cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process will be conducted by the District Level Selection Committee, Purulia. The method differs by post. Selection is as per marks obtained in the GNM examination. The Pharmacist selection carries Total Marks 100: Original documents are verified at the document verification stage. Inclusion of a name in the list of candidates called for Computer Test/Interview/Document Verification does not confer any right to appointment, and candidature stays provisional until all original documents are verified.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CMOH Purulia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 Staff Nurse (NUHM) posts (ST-1, EWS-1) and 1 Pharmacist (NUHM) post (UR-1).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application runs from 19.11.2026 (10:00 hrs) to 03.12.2026, but the last date of online registration is 02.12.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Staff Nurse (NUHM) post?
faq.answer: The GNM course by Indian Nursing Council OR the B.Sc. Nursing Course, registration under WBNC and proficiency in the local language.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Pharmacist (NUHM) post?
faq.answer: A two years Diploma in Pharmacy (D-Pharma) (Allopathic) recognized by the Government of West Bengal, registration as "A" category Pharmacist under West Bengal Pharmacy Council, and efficiency in computers including MS Office and internet.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Staff Nurse: maximum 40 years; Pharmacist: minimum 18 years and maximum 40 years, both as on 01.04.2026, with relaxation for reserved categories as per West Bengal Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs.25,000/- per month for Staff Nurse (NUHM) and Rs.22,000/- per month for Pharmacist (NUHM).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online only at www.wbhealth.gov.in under Quick links → Career, Education & Recruitment → Online Recruitment; no physical documents are to be sent to the office.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Staff Nurses are selected as per marks obtained in the GNM examination; Pharmacists on 100 marks – up to 85 for proportionate qualification marks and 15 for a Computer Test with minimum 50% qualifying marks.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: Yes, a candidate may apply for more than one post if he/she meets the eligibility of each post, but only one application is allowed per post.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely contractual and temporary in nature under the National Health Mission.
